description: Return Magist’s closed catalogs of valid product feature ids and target market ids, each with a short human-readable label -- the exact identifiers compute_requirements accepts as "features" and "markets". Use this to validate ids before calling compute_requirements; ids outside these catalogs are rejected with an actionable error. Deterministic and reproducible; this is reference data, not itself a regulatory determination.
name: list_feature_catalog
title: List supported features and markets
